comment: The views the ACRYL frame is compared in, with the viewports each is taken at. A view is a path plus steps to reach the state (text of a button or its aria-label); 'mask' lists regions that change on every run (a clock, a token) and are left out of the comparison. The ACRYL reference set must use the same names: <view>@<width>x<height>.png.
